subject: rt-algn
title: RT.ALGN.-----ALT.F.
description: Chart on book p. 394 (R(AS)CM(II)-38). RT-ALGN (reality alignment) is the subject; ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism), ECO-DYM (economic dynamics) and C-INFO (composite information). From CRTF-PROG: POL-P (political policies). From ECO-DYM: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From C-INFO: BIA (bi-aitional) and MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From POL-P: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification). From MT-DEVF: PHY-U-C (physical universe context).
